mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (event_id, event_type, project_key, environment_key, flag_key, version, payload, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{projectKey}, #{environmentKey}, #{flagKey}, #{version}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, event_type, project_key, environment_key, flag_key, version, payload, status, created_at, updated_at FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'SENT', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
